title: Critical and quenched near-critical universality for Poisson–Voronoi percolation

result.label: Critical and quenched near-critical universality for Poisson–Voronoi percolation
result.statement: Proves Cardy's formula for annealed critical Poisson–Voronoi crossing probabilities in every bounded Jordan quadrilateral. With each model normalized by its own expected unit-square pivotal count, the conditional joint near-critical crossing-threshold laws for rational polygonal quads converge in environment probability to the triangular-lattice reference law. This establishes quenched near-critical universality for crossing thresholds.
